sentences.en: The researchers running the multicenter CALERIE study are trying to determine whether restricting food intake can slow the aging process and extend our life span.

sentences.en: But in a recent multicenter study, the only menu change that had a significant payoff for dieters was cutting back on sugary beverages, says lead author Benjamin Caballero, MD.
